items.title: Shares of Memory Giants Drop on Soft Guidance

items.title: Western Digital (WDC) Stock May Be 49% Undervalued After AI Storage Deal Talks

After a sharp pullback in recent weeks and fresh news around long term AI storage demand, investors are weighing how much of the story is already reflected in the current price.
